D.pairing: clone environment and visible conversation at admissible prefix; separate control continuation per fault

M.scope: Public development panel, not unseen-source evaluation

human.interface: Buttons and graphical actions; no written answer or JSON required
human.comparison: Between-participant conditions, not matched-history human trajectories

decisionBudget: max(40, 6*N+20) per track; M additionally 4*N+12 manipulation attempts
capNote: No paid calls are authorized by this planning artifact alone; execution remains a later task.

perceptionProbe.source: 24 D/M pairs already selected in human schedules
perceptionProbe.images: certified fixed checkpoint before/after; same image pairs for all models
perceptionProbe.response: separate change/no-change and affected-piece/slot selection; no repair hint or legality feedback
perceptionProbe.purpose: not interrupting continuous episodes; human readability rated independently

crossRecovery.bank: normal siblings of the 12 D + 12 M predefined panel pairs; no external intervention during source collection
crossRecovery.stateAdmission: save the first accepted model attachment adding an off-target placement; certify a legal reconstruction witness; retain no-event or uncertified cases without substituting later states; off-target does not imply the original episode would fail
crossRecovery.conditioning: identical state, target, remaining inventory, observations and fresh context for each recoverer; report source and recoverer; source identity hidden
crossRecovery.controls: same-state source-model restart; original self-continuation reported separately
crossRecovery.implementation: PLANNED; no state bank exists yet

robustness.rule: identical task pixels/poses except intended observation change; no fabricated corruption or fault hints

strategies.openLoop: generate action script once, execute one brick at a time; record observations without giving them back; no scripted GT actions
strategies.doubleBudget: double decisions only; manipulation cap unchanged and reported
strategies.reasoning: no private chain-of-thought scoring; record supported native effort and token usage

additionalDesign.implementationStatus: design only; observation variants, paired runner, probe UI and recovery state bank require implementation before execution
